en.title: Warframe's Next Chapter, Tau, Arrives 2026 With New Warframe and Fortnite Crossover
en.summary: Digital Extremes has pulled back the curtain on the future of its beloved looter shooter, Warframe, unveiling a massive new narrative chapter set to launch in 2026. TennoCon 2026 brought with it a slate of exciting announcements, including a brand-new Warframe, a novel in-game mini-game, and an unexpected collaboration with Fortnite.
en.body:
The annual **TennoCon** celebration has once again delivered a treasure trove of reveals for the dedicated **Warframe** community. Developer **Digital Extremes** has officially announced **Warframe: Tau**, the next major narrative chapter that will transport players to an entirely new Star Chart, the Tau System. This ambitious expansion is slated for a free release on all platforms in 2026, promising a fresh journey for the over 85 million players who have embarked on the road ahead.

Alongside the unveiling of **Tau**, players were treated to the reveal of **Brysko**, a brand-new Sentient Warframe. This addition marks another step in the game's ever-expanding roster of playable characters. Furthermore, **Warframe** is introducing its first-ever playing card mini-game, adding a new layer of casual engagement beyond the core combat and looting loop. These significant additions are part of **Digital Extremes**' ongoing commitment to evolving the **Warframe** experience, ensuring a dynamic and engaging universe for its passionate player base.

## A New System and a Familiar Face

The **Warframe: Tau** chapter represents a monumental undertaking, taking players to a previously unexplored region of the game's vast cosmos. This new Star Chart is expected to introduce novel environments, enemy factions, and story elements that will deepen the lore **Warframe** players have come to cherish. While specific details about the new enemy faction and environmental designs are still emerging, the promise of a completely fresh canvas for adventure is a significant draw. The announcement also teased new music to accompany this fresh journey, further enhancing the immersive experience that **Digital Extremes** is known for.

## Unexpected Alliances and Community Excitement

Perhaps one of the most surprising announcements from **TennoCon** was the **Warframe** collaboration with **Epic Games**' massively popular battle royale, **Fortnite**. The Void, a core element of **Warframe**'s identity, is joining the **Fortnite** universe, allowing players to earn an **Excalibur** skin. This crossover signifies a remarkable convergence of two titans in the gaming world, potentially introducing **Warframe** to a new audience and offering a novel way for **Fortnite** players to engage with the beloved character. The community's reaction has been a mix of excitement and curiosity, eager to see how these two distinct universes will interact.

## What's Next

With **Warframe: Tau** targeting a 2026 launch, players can anticipate further details and gameplay reveals in the lead-up to its release. The **Fortnite** collaboration is expected to roll out soon, offering a tangible taste of this cross-universe event. The introduction of **Brysko** and the new card mini-game also signal ongoing content drops that will keep the **Warframe** experience fresh and engaging.
